requestedActions.title: List active task titles, including paginated results

guide.summary: Reading active task titles uses OAuth with the data:read scope and GET /api/v1/tasks, paginated by next_cursor. data:read is broader than tasks because it also covers projects, labels and filters. Provider review and customer distribution requirements are not established by the supplied passages.

findings.title: Authorization URL uses client_id, scope and state
findings.detail: Customers are redirected to the Todoist OAuth authorize endpoint with the app client_id, a requested scope and a state value to approve the connection.
findings.appliesWhen: Applies to OAuth connection of customer accounts.

evidence.quote: https://app.todoist.com/oauth/authorize?client_id = 0123456789abcdef & scope = data:read,data:delete & state = secretstring & response_type = code
Redirect users to the authorization URL at the endpoint

findings.title: Request data:read for task reads
findings.detail: data:read grants read-only access to application data including tasks, projects, labels and filters. Request it for the task listing action.
findings.appliesWhen: Applies when the OAuth app needs read access to active tasks.

evidence.quote: data:read Grants read-only access to application data, including tasks, projects, labels, and filters.

findings.title: data:read is broader than tasks
findings.detail: The supplied passages document no narrower task-only scope. Tokens issued with data:read can also read projects, labels and filters, so the app must not treat the token as task-only.
findings.appliesWhen: Applies to every OAuth token issued with data:read.

evidence.quote: data:read Grants read-only access to application data, including tasks, projects, labels, and filters.

findings.title: Task listing is cursor-paginated
findings.detail: GET /api/v1/tasks is paginated. Continue requesting pages until next_cursor is null; the page and offset parameters are not supported.
findings.appliesWhen: Applies when collecting all active task titles.

evidence.quote: Process all pages or stop early : If you need all results, continue fetching pages until next_cursor is null . Stop early if you've found what you need.
Note: The page and offset parameters are not supported on this API version.
} When next_cursor is null , you've reached the end of the results.

findings.title: Task responses return results with id and content
findings.detail: The supplied task response sample shows a results array whose entries include id fields. A content field appears in other sample objects, so confirm the title field on the first response.
findings.appliesWhen: Applies when mapping task titles from the response.

steps.title: Test first page of active tasks
steps.detail: Call GET /api/v1/tasks with limit=50 using the test account OAuth access token in the Authorization Bearer header. Each object in results carries its task text in the content field, which is the task title for this listing. Boundary check: confirm the outgoing request is a GET with no body and that no create, update, complete or delete calls are made.
steps.doneWhen: First page returns a results array and a next_cursor value for the test account, and each result exposes content as the title text.

steps.doneWhen: The loop stops only when next_cursor is null and all titles are collected.

steps.doneWhen: Paging repeats with each returned next_cursor until next_cursor is null, which marks the documented end of results.
